:::{#exm-estimated-cohen-kappa}
#### Estimated Cohen's kappa for the COVID-19 test

For the [agreement table](#def-agreement-table) of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
the [estimated overall agreement](#def-estimated-overall-agreement) is $\Est{p}_o = 0.99$ (@exm-estimated-overall-agreement)
and the [estimated chance agreement](#def-estimated-chance-agreement) is $\Est{p}_e = 0.862404$ (@exm-estimated-chance-agreement),
so the [estimated Cohen's kappa](#def-estimated-cohen-kappa) is:

$$
\ba
\ek
&= \frac{0.99 - 0.862404}{1 - 0.862404}
&& \text{(definition of } \ek \text{)} \\
&= \frac{0.127596}{1 - 0.862404}
&& \text{(subtract in the numerator)} \\
&= \frac{0.127596}{0.137596}
&& \text{(subtract in the denominator)} \\
&\approx 0.927
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-estimated-cohen-kappa}

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
kappa_from_table <- function(a, b, c, d) {
  n <- a + b + c + d
  p_o_hat <- (a + d) / n
  p_e_hat <- ((a + b) * (a + c) + (c + d) * (b + d)) / n^2
  (p_o_hat - p_e_hat) / (1 - p_e_hat)
}
do.call(kappa_from_table, as.list(agree_covid))
```

This [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) equals [Cohen's kappa](#def-cohen-kappa) $\kappa \approx 0.927$ of @exm-cohen-kappa-covid,
because $\Est{p}_o = p_o$ and $\Est{p}_e = p_e$.

:::
